inherited_five_class_description: Some earlier reports described missing v6 as five-class. That is inherited narrative, not authenticated by original v6 bytes. Preserved historical artifacts are not rewritten; this round does not assert that original class count.
audio_corpus_vs_joint_corpus: The 288 TRAIN audio recordings and 1536-dimensional pretrained descriptor are a separate development corpus from the original 55-dimensional joint AV packets; results do not cross-qualify frontends or dynamics.
statistical_comparisons: Joint full/margin training-by-execution contrasts are separate from ordinary/HX by fixed/value control contrasts. No overloaded A/B/C/D label is used as original D-B without its explicit context.
